name: TELADAN
recent: Teladan Group Berhad 近期持续进行股份回购，自2026年10月至11月几乎每个交易日都有回购公告。公司2026年第二季度净利同比增长42.4%至931万令吉，营收同比增长31.0%。董事总经理Teo Lay Ban在闭市期前表示有意进行交易。
notable: 公司自2026年10月中旬起持续在公开市场进行股份回购。
2026年第二季度净利同比增长42.4%至931万令吉。
董事总经理Teo Lay Ban在闭市期前表示有意进行证券交易。
risks: 董事总经理在闭市期前表示有意进行交易，需留意后续股权变动。
earnings: 2026年第二季度营收8800万令吉，同比增31.0%，环比减8.9%；净利931万令吉，同比增42.4%，环比减8.4%；净利率10.6%，上季为10.5%。

recent_en: Teladan Group Berhad has been conducting ongoing share buybacks, with announcements on almost every trading day from October to November 2026. The company's 2Q2026 net profit rose 42.4% year-on-year to RM9.31 million, with revenue up 31.0% year-on-year. Managing Director Teo Lay Ban indicated an intention to deal during the closed period.
notable_en: The company has been continuously buying back shares on the open market since mid-October 2026.
2Q2026 net profit rose 42.4% year-on-year to RM9.31 million.
Managing Director Teo Lay Ban indicated an intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
risks_en: The Managing Director indicated an intention to deal ahead of the closed period; subsequent changes in shareholding should be monitored.
earnings_en: 2Q2026 revenue was RM88.0 million, up 31.0% year-on-year and down 8.9% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM9.31 million, up 42.4% year-on-year and down 8.4% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 10.6% versus 10.5% in the previous quarter.
